Liqeni i Thatë – zonë e qetë, e gjelbëruar dhe me ajër të pastër 🌳
Akses i menjëhershëm me Unazën e Madhe dhe qendrën e Tiranës
Pranë shkollave, supermarketeve dhe çdo shërbimi të nevojshëm!
description_en: 📢 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT DRY LAKE! 🏡 In one of the most elite and quiet areas of Tirana, a modern 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, ideal for family living or safe investment! ✨ Apartment details: 🔹 3rd floor 🔹 New, quality construction 🔹 Perfect floor plan with natural lighting throughout the day 🔹 Spacious living room + contemporary kitchen 🔹 2 comfortable bedrooms 🔹 1 modern bathroom 🔹 Balcony with a relaxing view 🔹 Elevator + regular administration 📍 Ideal location: Dry Lake - quiet, green area with fresh air 🌳 Immediate access to the Great Ring Road and the center of Tirana Nearby schools, supermarkets and every necessary service!
